name: Christmas Gift Planner & Budget Tracker
title: Christmas Gift Planner Spreadsheet, Christmas Budget Tracker, Gift List Template, Holiday Budget, Card List, Excel & Google Sheets
description:
Plan every gift, stay on budget and see what's left to buy at a glance.

WHAT YOU GET
• Budget: set your total and split it across gifts, food, decorations, cards, travel and more
• Gift list for up to 150 people: idea, where to buy, budget vs actual, status from idea to given
• Other spending log for food, decorations, cards and travel
• Dashboard: spent, left to spend, gifts still to buy and the countdown to Christmas
• Spending by group (family, kids, friends, work...)
• Christmas card list with sent and received

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Budget, Gift List (150 rows), Other Spending, Dashboard, Cards.

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx). Opens in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (upload to Google Drive, then open with Google Sheets). Also works in Apple Numbers and LibreOffice, though drop-down lists may look different.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open the file and type your numbers in the yellow cells.
3. Everything else is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For personal use. Please don't share or resell the file.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.

name: Printable Christmas Gift Tags
title: Printable Christmas Gift Tags, Holiday Gift Labels, To From Tags, Round Christmas Stickers, Red Green Gift Wrap Tags, Instant Download
description:
48 original gift tags, 12 round labels and 16 To/From labels to print at home this Christmas.

WHAT YOU GET
• 48 tags in 6 colourways: cream, sage, forest green, berry red, frost blue and cocoa
• 8 original designs: pine, bauble, stars, snowflake, holly, tree, mitten and gift
• 12 round 2-inch labels (print on sticker paper for stickers)
• 16 To / From labels
• Cut lines on every page; punch a hole for ribbon or twine
• US Letter and A4

INSIDE
Instructions page, 6 pages of tags, Round labels, To/From labels.

FILES
2 PDF files: US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) and A4.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Print at 100% / actual size on white cardstock.
3. Cut along the dashed lines, punch a hole and tie on with ribbon or twine.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For personal use. You may use printed pieces in handmade items you sell (for example journals and cards), but please don't share or resell the files.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.
